name: El Shaddai for Android Vol. 2
summary:
El Shaddai for Android Vol. 2 is the second installment in a three-part side-scrolling action game series based on El Shaddai: Ascension of the Metatron.

Released for Android devices through GMO Game Center's G-Gee service in Japan in January 2012, the game continues Enoch's journey to capture the fallen angels and prevent the destruction of humanity.
